scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I recently applied for a VA home purchase loan, and I wanted to check on the status of my application. Could you tell me if it's been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, I'd like to know what the interest rate is and the total costs associated with the loan.
dialogue.agent: Your VA home purchase loan application has been approved. The interest rate for your loan is 7.25%, and the total loan costs are $725.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Thank you for letting me know. I also wanted to ask, what is the loan term for my approved loan, and has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The loan term for your approved VA loan is 360 months, and the loan has been purchased by Ginnie Mae.

dialogue.user: Got it, thank you. I don't see any mention of high-cost or negative amortization flags in the information provided. Could you confirm if there are any such flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. I have one more question: Could you share the debt-to-income ratio that was considered for my application?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include the debt-to-income ratio for your application.

dialogue.user:
I see. That's all the questions I have for now. Thank you for your help.

<Very Satisfied> - The agent provided clear and concise answers to all my questions, and I felt well-informed about the status and details of my loan application.
